Messages.Author: Rob Grau
Messages.Body:
bobb...@my-deja.com wrote:
<--snip intro-->

>
> Vamps (20)
> 1 Uma Hatch (3, Brujah, pre)
> 1 Vasilis (2, Brujah, pre, giovanni gets +1 bleed)
> 2 Delilah Easton (2, Toreador, pre)
> 1 Dieter Kleist (2, Toreador)
> 3 Gideon Fontaine (3, Ventrue, PRE)
> 1 Roland Loussarian (3, Ventrue, pre)
> 2 Angela Decker (1, Pander, if burned pay 2, pre)
> 2 Igo the Hungry (1, Caitiff, pre, -1 stealth hunt)
> 2 Antoinette Duchamps (1, Caitiff, pre)
> 1 Smudge the Ignored (1, Caitiff)
> 1 Navar McLaren (1, Caitiff, cannot block older)
> 1 Nik (1, Caitiff, brujah +1 intercept)

> 2 Frederick the Weak (2, !Brujah ,pre)

20 Vamps are a lot more than you need. I would toss out some of your
doubled vamps, particularly Angela, Igo, Antoinette, and Fredrick. Then
drop to two Gideons. If you want to get lots of vamps out in a hurry it
sucks to have duplicates in your crypt draw. I'm guessing that Dieter is
here for the Toreador Justicar. Drop him in favor of Marianna Gilbert.
Just worry about the Ventrue if you want a cheap presence Justicar. I'd
also add Itzahk Levine to the mix. Other cheap presence vamps you could
include are Lolita and Khalil Anvari. If you want two clan justicars,
consider the Brujah one, and add Yuri or Hector.

> Masters (22)
> 7 Presence
> 4 Blood doll
> 3 Elysium - arboretum
> 1 Elysium - versailles
> 3 Information highway
> 1 Ventrue Headquarters
> 1 Fragment of the Book of Nod
> 1 Dreams of the Sphinx
> 1 Barrens

Selection of masters is pretty good. If you tune your crypt, you can
probably drop the presence masters to five. You might get rid of the
Barrens for space, You already have the Dreams and the Fragment, and
Barrens will be contested more than the other two. (Or drop the Fragment
so you won't have to go retrieve it constantly, this will depend on your
playgroup.)

> Presence (22)
> 8 Bewitching oration
> 6 Majesty
> 5 Voter captivation
> 1 Entrancement
> 2 Aire of Elation

Drop the entrancement, unless you're trying to steal allies. I'd replace
it with another Aire.

> Votes (35)
> 11 Reversal of Fortunes
> 1 Ventrue Justicar
> 1 Toreador justicar

> 8 Praxis seizure?s

> 1 Autarktis
> 1 Disputed territory
> 1 Kindred restructure
> 8 Kine Resources Contested
> 2 Rumours of Gehenna
> 1 Camarilla Threat

Many people have already pointed out the problem with your Reversal of
Fortunes plan. Some solutions: a) Drop them in favor of a straight vote
deck. b) get weanie malkavians, use presence masters, and use Madness
Network. c) Increase the number of Kindred Restructures to take
advantage of the Reversal of Fortunes votes.

Votes I would drop from the deck: The justicars, (too hard to pull off)
Disputed Territory, Rumours, Camarilla Threat. Possibly the Autarktis.
This isn't because the votes are bad. You just need space. Votes to add:
Banishment. Kinda cheesy, but if you need to get rid of an IC for a turn
or two, it does the trick.

> Miscallenous (1)
> 1 Embrace

Another thing for the justicar vote, right? Well, most of your vamps are
2 cap or smaller, so I'd drop it both for space and for feasability
reasons. You can do better things with the card slot.

Rob Grau
